entries.headline: Kawasaki P-1 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Kawasaki P-1 with call sign 0, hex code 87C844 and registration 5521. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Rosneft refinery-repair slowdown reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that Russian oil company Rosneft was slowing some refinery repairs because repeated Ukrainian strikes were causing recurring damage.

entries.headline: U.S. transport and surveillance aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and an Air Force surveillance jet airborne over the continental United States, with routine coded radio activity continuing.

entries.headline: Strait of Hormuz missile-launch report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Conflict Radar report that an Iranian anti-ship missile launch was detected toward the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.headline: AE0859 KC-135 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing KC-135R/T Stratotanker with no call sign, hex code AE0859 and registration 59-1506. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to MH_Spotter via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: U.S. military and customs aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four U.S. Air Force heavy transport aircraft, a surveillance aircraft and a customs drone airborne over the continental United States, along with one coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcast.

entries.headline: U.S. and Black Sea military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft over the continental United States, with Black Sea military-flight activity at more than five times the usual level.

entries.headline: Russian strikes on Kyiv and Odesa report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a BBC report of major Russian strikes on Kyiv and Odesa after Russia said it was ready in principle to resume peace talks.

entries.headline: Starlink disruptions investigation call highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Stars and Stripes report that lawmakers called for an investigation into the source of Starlink disruptions in Ukraine.

entries.headline: North Atlantic and UK military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts that day, along with multiple large transport aircraft and a NATO surveillance jet over the North Atlantic and United Kingdom region.

entries.headline: Tal al-Hawa vehicle-strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report that two people were killed and several injured in an Israeli airstrike on a vehicle in Tal al-Hawa. The post said three outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: 252-body repatriation report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that Ukraine received the bodies of 252 people which the Russian side claimed belonged to Ukrainian citizens, including service members. The post said two outlets had confirmed the report.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 360 departures across four Las Vegas-area airfields by mid-afternoon Wednesday following NBAA-BACE, including 148 departures from Harry Reid International Airport.

entries.headline: N333QS North Las Vegas arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a one-take replay of N333QS, a Phenom 300, flying from Van Nuys to North Las Vegas and continuing from the valley to touchdown and back.

entries.headline: Harry Reid ramp aircraft counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 38 aircraft on one Harry Reid ramp and 26 on another on Wednesday morning during NBAA-BACE, shown in four frames from the valley to the ramp.

entries.headline: KLAS show-week ramp tour shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a continuous tour of the KLAS ramp, noting that show-week ground activity becomes difficult after aircraft land.

entries.headline: Las Vegas Strip helicopter replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 120-times-speed replay of Tuesday evening helicopter tours operating from Harry Reid International Airport, along the Las Vegas Strip and back.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of NBAA-BACE day-one peak traffic covering KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU, followed by a whole-valley view.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE Tuesday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas valley traffic down 9% and business-jet traffic down 19% on Tuesday, October 20, compared with Monday, based on SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: Las Vegas valley traffic peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of the previous day’s peak traffic across four Las Vegas-area airfields.
